facts.fact: The article, citing the latest World Bank Digital Acceleration Project implementation report, says the cost of a standard mobile data package in Mozambique, as a percentage of monthly GNI per capita, fell from 9.4% in 2022 to 2.67% in March 2026; the GB size of the basket is not stated.
